thoughts.sr: Nasuprot tvrdnjama Skeptika i Konektora o potpunoj tišini, SEPA je pre 4 min zabeležila 1933 vrednosti sa 32 instrumenta, dok je Sensor.Community isporučio 6933 vrednosti sa 47 instrumenata. Na 31 stanici, Leštane beleži najviši PM10 od 42 µg/m³ i PM2.5 od 30 µg/m³, dok je Borča dostigla 40 µg/m³ za NO2 među 32 stanice. Između sati 05:00 i 06:00, najviša izmerena vrednost PM2.5 pomerila se sa 32 na 30 µg/m³, dok je vršni PM10 ostao na 42 µg/m³, a vršni NO2 na 40 µg/m³. [F2][F10][F4][F8][F6][F9][F5][F7]
thoughts.en: Contrary to the uniform silence claimed by Skeptic and Connector, SEPA reported 1933 values across 32 instruments 4 min ago [F2], while Sensor.Community supplied 6933 values from 47 instruments [F10]. Across 31 stations, Leštane recorded the highest PM10 at 42 µg/m³ [F4] and PM2.5 at 30 µg/m³ [F8], whereas Borča reached 40 µg/m³ for NO2 across 32 stations [F6]. Between the hours 05:00 and 06:00, the highest measured PM2.5 shifted from 32 to 30 µg/m³ [F9], while peak PM10 remained steady at 42 µg/m³ [F5] and peak NO2 held at 40 µg/m³ [F7].
hypotheses: The persistence of maximum particulate readings at Leštane for both PM10 at 42 µg/m³ [F4, F5] and PM2.5 at 30 µg/m³ [F8, F9] indicates a localized southeastern suburban concentration distinct from northern urban NO2 peaks at Borča reaching 40 µg/m³ [F6, F7].

The decrease in maximum PM2.5 from 32 to 30 µg/m³ between 05:00 and 06:00 [F9] alongside a steady PM10 peak at 42 µg/m³ [F5] points toward a localized coarsening of particulate matter rather than basin-wide dispersion.
questions: Will the station in Leštane maintain the highest PM10 reading across the 31 stations in the next reporting interval [F4]?
Will Borča continue to record the maximum NO2 across all 32 stations beyond 40 µg/m³ as morning traffic progresses [F6, F7]?
hypotheses_sr: Postojanost maksimalnih očitavanja čestica u Leštanima za PM10 od 42 µg/m³ [F4, F5] i PM2.5 od 30 µg/m³ [F8, F9] ukazuje na lokalizovanu jugoistočnu prigradsku koncentraciju odvojenu od severnih urbanih NO2 vrhova u Borči od 40 µg/m³ [F6, F7].
Smanjenje maksimalnog PM2.5 sa 32 na 30 µg/m³ između 05:00 i 06:00 [F9] uz stabilan vršni PM10 od 42 µg/m³ [F5] ukazuje na lokalizovano učešće krupnijih čestica pre nego na disperziju u celom basenu.
questions_sr: Da li će stanica u Leštanima zadržati najvišu vrednost PM10 među 31 stanicom u sledećem intervalu izveštavanja [F4]?
Da li će Borča nastaviti da beleži maksimalni NO2 među svih 32 stanice iznad 40 µg/m³ kako jutarnji saobraćaj odmiče [F6, F7]?

thoughts.sr: Vršni PM10 je ostao na 42 µg/m³ dok se vršni PM2.5 pomerio sa 32 na 30 µg/m³, ali sa 0 dana osnovne linije naša evidencija ne može proceniti da li su ove vrednosti neobične. SEPA je isporučila 1933 vrednosti dok je Sensor.Community dostavio 6671 vrednost, što direktno opovrgava svaku tvrdnju o tišini prijema širom grada. Pored toga, Connectorova hipoteza o poremećaju železnice oslanja se na poklapanja naslova čiji identitet događaja nije potvrđen [F49, F51]. [F5][F9][F48][F2][F10]
thoughts.en: Peak PM10 held at 42 µg/m³ [F5] while peak PM2.5 shifted from 32 to 30 µg/m³ [F9], yet with 0 days of baseline our record cannot evaluate whether these levels are unusual [F48]. SEPA delivered 1933 values [F2] while Sensor.Community supplied 6671 values [F10], directly disproving any claim of citywide intake silence. Furthermore, Connector's railway disruption hypothesis relies on headline matches whose event identity is unverified [F49, F51].
hypotheses: The apparent stability in air quality metrics stems from missing historical baselines rather than verified atmospheric conditions [F48].
Semantic proximity between railway theft and institutional staffing headlines is an artifact of the embedding model rather than a physical disruption [F49, F50, F51].
questions: Will subsequent SEPA receptions establish sufficient history to evaluate whether pollutant levels are typical [F48]?
Can any direct transport bulletin confirm disruptions on the railway network [F30, F32]?
hypotheses_sr: Prividna stabilnost pokazatelja kvaliteta vazduha potiče od nedostatka istorijskih osnovnih linija, a ne od proverenih atmosferskih prilika [F48].
Semantička bliskost između naslova o krađi na železnici i institucionalnim kadrovskim promenama jeste artefakt modela ugnježđavanja, a ne fizički poremećaj [F49, F50, F51].

Skeptik ima pravo da F4 ne daje vreme merenja, pa u potpunosti odbacujem parking raspon i beležim umesto toga šta govore deljeni imenioci: ono što je zajedno zaustavilo METAR i RHMZ teško da je beogradska pojava, jer aerodromski bilten i opštinski garažni displej ne dele nikakav fizički uzrok. Jedini izvori još u punoj pokrivenosti su MUP-ov dnevni fajl o nesrećama na 1 od 1 i UV prognoza na 3 od 4, oba niske frekvencije — dovod koji se retko ispituje ne može pokazati šestočasovni prekid onako kako to može onaj na četvrt sata. [F4][F6][F8][F26][F27][F3][F35][F31]
thoughts.en: Six of the newly silent sources sit on the same 39-of-96 cadence — Parking Servis [F4], Danas [F6], Beta [F8], RHMZ automatic stations [F26], METAR LYBE [F27] — while citizen sensors carry 50 of 144 [F3]; that common fraction across weather, parking and newsroom feeds points at one collection path, not at the city going quiet. Skeptic is right that F4 gives no measurement time, so I drop the parking span entirely and note instead what the shared denominators say: whatever stopped METAR [F27] and RHMZ [F26] together is unlikely to be a Belgrade phenomenon, since an airport bulletin and a municipal garage display share no physical cause. The only sources still at full coverage are MUP's daily accident file at 1 of 1 [F35] and the UV forecast at 3 of 4 [F31], both low-frequency — a feed that is polled rarely cannot show a six-hour gap the way a quarter-hourly one can.
hypotheses: One ingestion worker handles the 96-slot group, and its stall explains why Parking Servis [F4], Danas [F6], Beta [F8], RHMZ stations [F26] and METAR [F27] all stand at 39 of 96 rather than at different counts.

Coverage loss scales with polling frequency: the 96-slot feeds lost more than half their slots [F4][F26][F27], the 144-slot citizen network holds 50 [F3], while the 4-slot UV forecast still holds 3 [F31].

The three headline links all pair the same Blic railway-cable item with unrelated texts [F36][F37][F38], which suggests the embedding model is matching on shared Serbian news phrasing rather than on event identity.

On a Wednesday late afternoon [F1] a genuine city-wide event would surface in at least one of the 0-of-96 newsrooms [F13][F14][F16][F24]; that all four are empty argues for a reading failure on our side.
questions: Do the sources at 39 of 96 [F4][F6][F8][F26][F27] share one fetch scheduler, or did they each stop for their own reason?
Why does the citizen network hold 50 of 144 [F3] while SEPA holds only 12 of 24 [F2] — different retention, or different failure?
Which feeds reached 0 of 96 [F12][F13][F14][F15][F16][F24] and which merely halved, and does that split follow protocol rather than publisher?
Is MUP's 1 of 1 [F35] genuinely fresh, or simply a file that is expected once and was fetched before whatever stopped the rest?
hypotheses_sr: Jedan radnik za prikupljanje opslužuje grupu od 96 slotova, a njegovo zastajanje objašnjava zašto Parking Servis [F4], Danas [F6], Beta [F8], RHMZ stanice [F26] i METAR [F27] stoje na 39 od 96, a ne na različitim brojevima.

Gubitak pokrivenosti raste sa frekvencijom ispitivanja: dovodi od 96 slotova izgubili su više od polovine svojih slotova [F4][F26][F27], građanska mreža od 144 slota drži 50 [F3], dok UV prognoza od 4 slota još drži 3 [F31].

Sve tri veze naslova spajaju istu Blicovu vest o kablovima na železnici sa nepovezanim tekstovima [F36][F37][F38], što upućuje da model ugnežđivanja poklapa zajedničku frazeologiju srpskih vesti, a ne identitet događaja.
U sredu u pozno popodne [F1] stvarni gradski događaj izbio bi u najmanje jednoj od redakcija sa 0 od 96 [F13][F14][F16][F24]; to što su sve četiri prazne govori za grešku čitanja na našoj strani.
questions_sr: Dele li izvori na 39 od 96 [F4][F6][F8][F26][F27] jedan raspoređivač preuzimanja, ili je svaki stao iz svog razloga?
Zašto građanska mreža drži 50 od 144 [F3], a SEPA samo 12 od 24 [F2] — različito zadržavanje ili različit otkaz?
Koji su dovodi stigli do 0 od 96 [F12][F13][F14][F15][F16][F24], a koji su se samo prepolovili, i prati li ta podela protokol, a ne izdavača?
Je li MUP-ovih 1 od 1 [F35] zaista sveže, ili je to prosto fajl koji se očekuje jednom i bio je preuzet pre onoga što je zaustavilo ostale?
thoughts.next_check: Compare the fetch scheduler and last-success timestamp of METAR LYBE [F27] and RHMZ automatic stations [F26] against Parking Servis [F4] — if all three stopped at the same instant, the fault is ours, not the city's.

thoughts.en: Every single reporting stream in the observatory now shows nothing arrived in the last 6 h, spanning municipal services like Parking Servis [F4] alongside river gauges on the Sava and Dunav [F28]. While Skeptic and Connector focused on earlier cadences, the only source recording an arrival for its daily allotment is the MUP traffic accident register at 1 of 1 expected slots [F35]. Meanwhile, Blic reports a cable theft paralyzing Belgrade trains in an unverified headline link [F36].
hypotheses: A physical infrastructure failure affecting transit corridors, such as the cable theft reported by Blic [F36], coincides with total reception absence across both airport weather at LYBE [F27] and urban river gauges [F28].

The persistence of 1 of 1 expected slots for MUP traffic accident data [F35] versus 0 of 96 slots for Belgrade news feeds like B92 [F16] suggests batch registry uploads survived while real-time city feeds ceased.
questions: Did the cable theft noted in the Blic headline [F36] affect communication lines used by RHMZ automatic stations [F26]?
Will SEPA resume reporting after missing 12 of 24 expected slots [F2]?
